title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to AWS Lambda and Amazon SES
description: Send an email with Amazon SES from an AWS Lambda function behind an Amazon API Gateway REST API.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern deploys an Amazon API Gateway REST API with a GET method, defined in an OpenAPI file. The method invokes an AWS Lambda function, which uses the AWS SDK for Python (Boto3) to send an email with a text and an HTML body through Amazon SES in the function's own Region.

You set the sender and recipient addresses as stack parameters. The function can only send from the sender address, and to the recipient address. Verify the sender in Amazon SES before you deploy. In the SES sandbox, verify the recipient too.
